idle: It's fine. It'll do the job.
Two of these six heaters work. I sit under the two.
I've been up since four. I'm fine.
good_ice: Ice looks good. Nobody's going to cry on it. Well. Less.
bad_ice: My kid's falling enough without the ice helping.
That surface wouldn't pass inspection at the Dairy.
wet_ice: Wet ice and wet mittens. Love that for us.
goal: Good. Somebody scored. Can we go home?
cold: I work in a dairy cooler and this is colder.
hungry: One coffee and whatever Maddie doesn't finish.
long_line: I supervise forty people. I could fix this line in a minute.
bored: I'll just check Dylan's grades online. No. I won't.
greet_owner: {owner}. Is my son working or pretending?
Hi. Don't ask me if I'm related to Gary.
leaving_happy: She let go. I'm not crying. It's the cold.
leaving_angry: I paid for a lesson, not a demolition derby.

learn_to_skate: Come on, baby. Knees soft. I'm not looking. I'm looking.
That chair has done more for her than any coach I've paid.
high_school: Josie's on D tonight. Dylan will be watching. Not the game.
minor_hockey: Rick Saucier is yelling again. Of course he is.
public_skate: I'll take one lap. One. I'm wearing my grandmother's skates, so be nice.

first.say: You're the owner. I'm Carla. Pruitt with an i. Dylan's mother, Maddie's mother, Dorothy Pruitt's granddaughter. No relation to Gary.

options.text: Dylan's a big help around here.
Pruitt like Honest Hockey?
Wait. Not even a little related to Gary?

first_hh.say: Grandma Dorothy started it because she watched my dad outgrow his skates by Easter. Plain gear, fair price. These are her skates. They're fine.

options.text: They look good for another fifty years.
The east bench heaters again? I'll get them looked at.

do.note: Carla Pruitt asked for the east bench heaters to be fixed.

options.text: Have a coffee on the house.
I hear you, Carla.

say: Don't talk to me, I'm watching her not let go of that chair.
She's up. She's up. She's... okay, she's down. She's up.

options.text: She's getting there, Carla.
I'll leave you to it.

say: Hey. Thanks for keeping an eye on both of mine.

options.text: Thanks, Carla.

say: It's fine. What do you need?
I've got twenty minutes before the bus. Go.
Hi. Dylan says you're 'basically his boss'. Are you?

options.text: How's the Dairy?
What do you like watching here?
How's Dylan doing, really?
You know Donna Pettigrew?
What do you think of the rink?
Take care, Carla.

job.say: Shift supervisor. Four a.m. starts, forty people, one forklift that only I can reverse. I sleep under the heaters at learn-to-skate. Sitting up.

options.text: Sounds a lot like running a rink.

events.say: Learn-to-skate, because I'm a mother. High school, because Dylan watches Josie, so I watch Dylan. Minor hockey if Rick Saucier isn't at the glass.

options.text: What's learn-to-skate like from the bench?
Somebody should talk to Rick.

events_lts.say: Like watching someone defuse a bomb, and the bomb is your kid. Colette is a saint. That girl could teach a fridge to glide.

options.text: I'll tell her you said so.

dylan.say: He's happy here. Happier than at school. If he's going to work here, I need to know his homework happens somewhere.

options.text: Homework at the counter before any shift. My rule.
He's a hard worker, Carla. He'll figure it out.
Is the homework rule working?

dylan_rule.say: Thank you. I mean it. He'll grumble, and then he'll do it, because it's you saying it and not me.

options.text: That's how it works.

dylan_after.say: His math teacher called me. To say something nice. I had to sit down.

options.text: That's a win.

donna.say: Donna's the only person in this valley more tired than me who still gets more done. I'd follow her into a blizzard. I have, actually. Bake sale.

options.text: I hear her bake sales are serious.

rink.say: Heaters. That's my review. Two of six on the east benches. Grandma would've written a letter.

options.text: And now the ice is better?
We fixed up the rooms. Better?
I'll get to the heaters.

rink_ice.say: Maddie falls less. I worry less. That's a good trade for both of us.

options.text: Glad to hear it.
